    <script type="text/javascript">
        var initialConsents = undefined;
        var areEventListenersBinded = false;

        function OptanonWrapper() {
            if (!areEventListenersBinded) {
                areEventListenersBinded = true;
                initialConsents = OnetrustActiveGroups;
            	setPolicyEventBindings();
            }
        }

        window.addEventListener("OTConsentApplied", () => {
            if ( shouldReloadPage() ) {
                reloadPage();
            }
        });

        const setPolicyEventBindings = function() {
            // Called when 'Accept all cookies' button is clicked on main on-page-load cookie banner
            const acceptAllButton = document.querySelector("button#onetrust-accept-btn-handler");
            if (acceptAllButton) {
                acceptAllButton.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
                    const attributes = {};
                    attributes.itemName = "Accept all cookies main";
                    reportAnalyticsDataOnPageReload(attributes);
                });
            }

            // Called when 'Reject all cookies' button is clicked on main on-page-load cookie banner
            const rejectAllButton = document.querySelector("button#onetrust-reject-all-handler");
            if (rejectAllButton) {
                rejectAllButton.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
                    const attributes = {};
                    attributes.itemName = "Reject all cookies main";
                    reportAnalyticsData(attributes);
                });
            }

            // Called when 'Accept Recommended Cookie' button is clicked on 'Cookie preferences' banner. Currently, this UI feature is disabled.
            const acceptRecommendedButton = document.querySelector("button#accept-recommended-btn-handler");
            if (acceptRecommendedButton) {
                acceptRecommendedButton.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
                    const attributes = {};
                    attributes.itemName = "All cookies accepted preference center";
                    reportAnalyticsDataOnPageReload(attributes);
                });
            }

            // Called when 'Save my cookie preferences' button is clicked on 'Cookie preferences' banner
            const savePreferenceButton = document.querySelector(".save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler");
            if (savePreferenceButton) {
                savePreferenceButton.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
                    const attributes = {};
                    attributes.itemName = "saved preferences";
                    reportAnalyticsDataOnPageReload(attributes);
                });
            }

            // Called when Close (X) button is clicked on 'Cookie preference' banner
            const closeButton = document.querySelector("button#close-pc-btn-handler")
            if (closeButton) {
                closeButton.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
                    const attributes = {};
                    attributes.itemName = "Cookie banner closed preference";
                    reportAnalyticsData(attributes);
                });
            }
        }

        const reportAnalyticsData = function(eventAttributes) {
            const e = prepareEventData(eventAttributes);
            window.digitalData.addEvent(e);
        }

        const reportAnalyticsDataOnPageReload = function(eventAttributes) {
            const e = prepareEventData(eventAttributes);
            e.setStrategy(udl.AnalyticsCallFireStrategyEnum.FIRE_ON_PAGE_RELOAD);
            window.digitalData.addEvent(e);
        }

        const prepareEventData = function(eventAttributes) {
            const eventInfo = new udl.EventInfo();
            eventInfo.setEventName("Cookie banner clicked");
            eventInfo.setType("click");

            const e = new udl.Event();
            e.setEventInfo(eventInfo);
            e.setAttributes(eventAttributes);
            return e;
        }

        const shouldReloadPage = function() {
            var oldConsents = initialConsents.split(',').sort();
            var newConsents = OnetrustActiveGroups.split(',').sort();
            return JSON.stringify(oldConsents) !== JSON.stringify(newConsents);
        }

        const reloadPage = function() {
            location.reload();
        }
    </script>


<!-- OneTrust Cookies Consent Notice end -->
